verdict.rationale: Docs confirm one-click install via existing GitHub/GitLab account with no credit card (quickstart), and review-command/request-changes-workflow docs plus a screenshot show CodeRabbit posting actionable inline comments and blocking PRs natively on GitHub. Community comments (comm-1, comm-6, comm-7) corroborate it actively reviewing PRs in practice, though some found it verbose/false-positive-prone (comm-2) which is a quality caveat, not a mechanism failure. Missing for 10: explicit 'within minutes' setup-time benchmark and direct confirmation of native inline-comment rendering specifically on GitLab (most evidence is GitHub-centric).
